Container.Name: deepseek-harness-tauri
Container.Overview: Remote DeepSeek Harness desktop via Selkies. Selkies serves HTTP on container port 8080; Pangolin handles user authentication and public HTTPS. Select the same existing user-defined Docker network used by the DinD container and Pangolin Site connector. Use deepseek-harness-tauri:8080 as Pangolin's HTTP backend. Do not publish a host port. Runtime identity is fixed at UID:GID 1000:1000 plus supplemental GID 100; PUID/PGID remapping is unsupported. Keep the deepseek-harness-dind container name unchanged.

Config.Name: Application home
Config.Description: Persistent app settings, DSH home, logs, and managed tooling. Runtime UID:GID is fixed at 1000:1000; supplemental GID 100 grants access to prepared host paths.

Config.Name: Workspaces
Config.Description: Persistent project workspace. Runtime UID:GID is fixed at 1000:1000; prepare the host path with GID 100 and setgid as documented.

Config.Name: DinD client TLS certificates
Config.Description: Client certificate files generated by the DinD container. Start DinD first. Read-only mount used to authenticate to its Docker API on port 2376.

Config.Name: Selkies Basic Auth disabled
Config.Description: Pangolin authenticates users at its HTTP/HTTPS resource; do not expose port 8080 directly.

Config.Name: Selkies HTTPS disabled
Config.Description: Pangolin terminates public TLS; Selkies backend uses HTTP on port 8080.

Config.Name: DinD endpoint
Config.Description: Client-authenticated TLS endpoint resolved by Docker DNS on the selected shared network. Do not publish port 2376.

Config.Name: DinD TLS verification
Config.Description: Require certificate verification for the DinD API connection.

Config.Name: DinD client certificate path
Config.Description: Read-only client certificate mount used for mutual TLS.
